title: Track parts
goal: Every spare and salvaged part the venture holds is listed with what it fits, where it is and what it cost, the list is true after each part is used or bought, and the spares worth holding are in front of the founder.

steps.do: List the spares and salvaged parts the venture holds, each with what it fits, its condition, how many there are, where it is kept and what it cost or which dismantled item it came from, and put the list on the handoff as the parts list the next repair reads.

consider.why: A repair that buys a part the venture already has in a drawer costs money and days for nothing.
consider.when: The venture holds physical equipment with spares, consumables or salvaged parts.

steps.do: Each time a part is used or bought, update its count and its location on that list, and flag every part that no longer fits anything the venture owns so it can be sold, recycled or given away.

consider.why: A parts list nobody updates is worse than none, because a repair plans around a part that is not there.
consider.when: The venture has used or bought a part since the last run.

steps.do: Recommend which spares are worth holding, weighing what the item costs the venture in lost days when it fails and how long the part takes to arrive against what holding it ties up, and leave the level to the founder.

Attach the parts list and the holding recommendation to the decisions they bear on (a spare to buy, a part to let go, a supplier whose lead time makes a spare necessary) and tell the finance lead what the recommendation costs.

done_criteria.check: Does the parts list name what each part fits, how many there are and where they are kept, and is every part that fits nothing the venture still owns flagged?
